source: Statutory charges on NSE and BSE equity derivatives and cash delivery (STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover fee, IPFT, GST). Rates as decimals of value; per-crore figures in rupees. Brokerage is not part of this table (it comes from config). `asOf` is the date of the OLDEST group below, because the table is only as current as its stalest figure. No group was read in an exchange circular: all are verified:false.

stt.circular: NSE/FATAX/73524 (Finance Act 2026 STT change; not opened)
stt.note: Secondary source (a broker bulletin). Futures sell 0.05%, options sale 0.15% of premium, exercise 0.15% of intrinsic value, effective 2026-04-01 (earlier 0.02%, 0.1%, 0.125%).

stampSebiGst.note: Secondary source (a broker charge page, undated). GST 18% applies to brokerage plus transaction charges plus the SEBI fee, not to STT or stamp duty.

nseTransactionCharges.note: The figures in this table are the rates in force until about 2026-02-28. NSE changed them with NSE/FA/73061, effective 2026-03-01 per press. A broker page read on 2026-11-10 shows futures 0.00183%, options 0.03553% of premium and cash 0.00307%, and an investor protection fund contribution of Rs 0.01 per crore; press is contradictory on that last figure. Those newer numbers are NOT applied: the circular was not read, and money maths is not changed without a primary source. The rupee effect is small (about 6 percent of the futures fee, 1.4 percent of the options fee).

bseTransactionCharges.note: Secondary source (a broker charge page, undated): options 0.0325%, futures 0, cash 0.00375% match this table.

physical.source: Cash-segment delivery rates applied to physical settlement of stock derivatives (needs verification: whether STT on physically settled stock options is charged at 0.1% to both the exercising buyer and the delivering seller was not verified)

margin.circular: NSE circular dated 2024-10-21, effective 2024-11-20 (named by broker pages; not opened)
margin.source: Additional expiry-day ELM on short index options (corroborated by broker pages, secondary; needs verification against the circular)
